deviations: UnitHyperbola branches are trimmed to the symmetric range [-3.0, 3.0]: the branch parameter is unbounded both ways and the unit hyperbola has no natural finite range; the chosen range is wide enough for on-carrier sampling (cosh(3) ~ 10).
UnitParabola is trimmed to the symmetric range [-3.0, 3.0]: its parameter is likewise unbounded with no natural finite range; chosen wide enough for on-carrier sampling.
disagreements: pcone_boundary_parabola: the packet's witness lists q = (-3, 0, 5) but states the cross as (p - o) x (q - o) = (0,1,0) x (-3,0,4) = (4, 0, 3). With q = (-3, 0, 5) the v-axis is (-3, 0, 0) and the raw normal is (0, 0, 3): a horizontal plane that cuts a circle, which cannot satisfy the parabola boundary Nz^2 = t^2(Nx^2+Ny^2) (9 = 0) and contradicts the required Parabola arm and the 'same raw normal (4, 0, 3)' note in test 6. The packet's own arithmetic (and its h = -3 statement with n_hat = (0.8, 0, 0.6)) forces q = (-3, 0, 9); the test is implemented with that point. The cross is then (0,1,0) x (-3,0,4) = (4, 0, 3) exactly, the invariant is exact, and the plane clears the apex.

The family/degeneracy interval construction uses plane.u_axis()/v_axis() (the carrier's f64 differences) enclosed before the cross, rather than three inari subtractions per difference from the stored points: the Plane struct's p and q fields are private to truck-geometry and only origin()/u_axis()/v_axis() are exposed (read_allow includes plane.rs). The packet's core invariant is preserved — the cross product itself is computed in inari, never an f64 cross enclosed after the fact — and on the dyadic witnesses the enclosed axes are exact, so the predicates stay exact.
notes: Implemented plane_cone in vendor/truck/truck-evidence/src/analytic/plane_cone.rs. The family is chosen by three_way(Nz^2, t^2*(Nx^2+Ny^2)) on the raw normal computed componentwise in inari; the degeneracy is the apex-through height h = (apex - origin).n_hat, also in inari; an undecidable predicate refuses NumericallyUnresolved with witness RootNotIsolated and spent Budget(0,0,0). The horizontal special case (n_hat.z == +-1.0) is handled first and stays dyadic. Emissions: circle (unit circle under frame), ellipse (principal-axes semi-axes; squared semi-axes sanity-checked in intervals per the SPEC_GAP rule), two hyperbola branches (same centre/rotation solve, transverse axis chosen by the sign of -F'), one parabola (eigen-frame vertex form, ru = 4/c along the axis, rv = 1 transverse, derivation commented in code), TangentPoint/TangentLine/TwoCurves(Line,Line) for the through-apex degenerate arms. The two-generator and tangent-generator azimuths are solved stably on the unit circle (delta*(c0,s0) +/- w*(-s0,c0), and the double-root vertex form delta*(c0,s0) for the parabola), each verified in inari to lie in the plane. Every Ok carries the exact certificate field-by-field (Method::Exact = decisive interval predicates on the f64 carrier parameters; emitted conic is the closed-form section, coordinates in f64, on-both-carriers to machine precision asserted with H-3-commented slack; no tau_rep).
